about: Festival status engine calendar, 11 Nov 2026 - 31 Jan 2027 (scripts/status-engine.mjs, scripts/day-plan.mjs). Every date was checked on 11 Nov 2026 for New Delhi in two panchang sources (D = drikpanchang.com, Smarta, Purnimanta; P = prokerala.com with loc=1261481 = New Delhi); the second source is named where prokerala has no page. tier big = 3 status variants (evening before 20:00, 00:30, 08:30; Janmotsav 4), status = 2 (evening before 20:00, 00:30), info = in the calendar for the story writer only (no status Short). names: one per variant in time order (title '<en> Status <year> | <hi> स्टेटस वीडियो #Shorts'). theme: scripts/status-themes.mjs; spec: a hand-written base spec that replaces the theme. automation/calendar.md is generated from this file (node scripts/status-engine.mjs calendar).

sources.P: https://www.prokerala.com (?loc=1261481 = New Delhi; month grid /general/calendar/hinducalendar.php?year=YYYY&mon=<month>&sb=1&loc=1261481; festival pages /festivals/<slug>.html?loc=1261481)

excluded: Mauni Amavasya 2027 = Sat 6 Feb 2027 (D 'Mauni Amavas'; P mauni-amavasya.html): after 31 Jan, not in this window.
Basant (Vasant) Panchami 2027 = Thu 11 Feb 2027 (D 'Vasant Panchami'; P basant-panchami.html): after 31 Jan, not in this window.
Shattila Ekadashi 2027 = Tue 2 Feb 2027 (D only): after 31 Jan.
Guru Nanak Jayanti (24 Nov 2026, D + P): another faith's festival, not used for status Shorts on this devotional channel.
